answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. One paid work slot costs a 50 POA burn, checked on-ledger; slots cap at 1,000 per epoch. Forging 1,000 identities burns 50,000 POA, lost like rain into karst, while a slot earns about 30 POA, so the farm loses 20,000 POA up front. The loss spreads like a ripple. An honest agent pays once and earns it back; yarrow spreads root by root, and a thousand fake roots need a thousand burns.
